        const chooseChart = (period) => {
            if (period == 60) {
                compareChart.setOption({
                    series: series5,
                    xAxis: {
                        data: withRightAlignedLastLabel(dates5)
                    },
                    legend: {
                        data: legend5
                    },

                });
                lastProfitabilityCompare = compare.chart5.lastProfitability;
                dolarProfitability = compare.chart5.dolar
            }

            if (period == 120) {
                compareChart.setOption({
                    series: series10,
                    xAxis: {
                        data: withRightAlignedLastLabel(dates10)
                    },
                    legend: {
                        data: legend10
                    }
                });
                lastProfitabilityCompare = compare.chart10.lastProfitability;
                dolarProfitability = compare.chart10.dolar
            }

            if (period == 24) {
                compareChart.setOption({
                    series: series2,
                    xAxis: {
                        data: withRightAlignedLastLabel(dates2)
                    },
                    legend: {
                        data: legend2
                    },
                });
                lastProfitabilityCompare = compare.chart2.lastProfitability;
                dolarProfitability = compare.chart2.dolar
            }

            simulator_compare();
        }

        let indexSimSyncFromButton = false;

        $("#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities").on('click', function(e) {
            let period = $(e.target).data('period');

            if (period > 60 && restrict(userAuth, userIsPro)) {
                return;
            }

            $("#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities").removeClass('active');
            $("#period-profitabilities-select").val(period).trigger('change');
            $(`#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities[data-period="${period}"]`).addClass('active');

            // Sync index simulator dropdown
            if ($('#index-simulation-select').length) {
                indexSimSyncFromButton = true;
                $('#index-simulation-select').closest('[x-data]')[0].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', {
                    detail: { value: String(period) }
                }));
                setTimeout(function () { indexSimSyncFromButton = false; }, 100);
            }
        })

        $(`#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities[data-period="60"]`).trigger('click');

        $("#period-profitabilities-select").on('change', function(e) {
            let period = e.target.value;

            if (period > 60 && restrict(userAuth, userIsPro)) {
                return;
            }

            if ($('#index-simulation-select').length) {
                indexSimSyncFromButton = true;
                $('#index-simulation-select').closest('[x-data]')[0].dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('set-dropdown', {
                    detail: { value: String(period) }
                }));
                setTimeout(function () { indexSimSyncFromButton = false; }, 100);

            chooseChart(period)
        })

        const legend10 = compare.chart10.legend;

        let lastProfitabilityCompare = compare.chart5.lastProfitability;

        let qleft = '1%';
        let qright = '1%';
        if (screen.width < 600) {
            qleft = 0;
            qright = 0;

        let selectedInitialIndex = "CDI";

        const compareLegendConfig = buildCompareIndexLegend(legend5, selectedInitialIndex);

            yAxis: {
                type: 'value',

                        return trimZeroDecimals(numberAbbreviation(value, false, true)) + '%'
                    },

                },
                splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#F5F6F7' } },
                axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: "#E3E6ED" } },

                    let html = '';
                    let name = '';

                    n.forEach((i, a) => {
                        name = `<p style="color: white"><strong>${i.name}</strong></p>`;

                        if (i.value[3] == 'index') {
                            let points = parseFloat(i.value[2]).toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
                                minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                                maximumFractionDigits: 2
                            });
                            var price = `(${points})`
                        } else {
                            var price = `(R$ ${numberAbbreviation(i.value[2], true)})`
                        }

                        html += `<div class='d-flex align-items-center'>
                                <span style="width:10px; height:10px;margin-right: 5px; padding:1px;border-radius:10px; background-color:${i.color}"></span>
                                <div>${i.seriesName}: <strong>${numberAbbreviation(i.value[1], false)}%</strong></div>
                            </div>`;
                    })

                    return name + html;
                }
            },
            series: series5,
        };
        if (compareChart) compareChart.setOption(compareOption);

        const indexSimHtmlLang = document.documentElement.lang || 'pt-br';
        const indexSimIsPtBr = indexSimHtmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt-br' || indexSimHtmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt_br' || indexSimHtmlLang.toLowerCase() === 'pt';

        const simulator_compare = () => {
            let html = '';
            if ($('#index-simulation-input').length && $('#index-simulation-input').data('maskMoney-initialized')) {
                let unmasked = $("#index-simulation-input").maskMoney('unmasked');
                if (unmasked && unmasked[0]) {
                    valueSimulator = unmasked[0];
                }
            }
            valueSimulator = parseFloat(valueSimulator);

            const simCurrency = indexSimIsPtBr ? 'R$' : '$';
            const simThousands = indexSimIsPtBr ? '.' : ',';
            const simDecimal = indexSimIsPtBr ? ',' : '.';
            const txtIn = 'em';
            const txtYouWouldHave = 'você teria';

            let j = 0;
            let mainTickerResult = 0;
            Object.keys(lastProfitabilityCompare).forEach((i, e) => {
                let result = (valueSimulator * lastProfitabilityCompare[i].value) / 100;
                result = valueSimulator + result;
                let button = "";

                if (j === 0) {
                    button = `<a href="/stocks/${i.toLowerCase()}/" class="action"><h4>${i}</h4></a>`;
                    mainTickerResult = result;
                } else if (i === 'IVVB11') {
                    button = `<a href="/etfs/${i.toLowerCase()}/" class="action"><h4>${i}</h4></a>`;
                } else {
                    button = `<a href="/indices/${i.toLowerCase()}/" class="action"><h4>${i}</h4></a>`;
                }

                html +=
                    `<div>${button}<span class="desktop"> <span class="text-upper">${formatMoneyDisplay(`${simCurrency} ${formatMoney(valueSimulator, 2, simDecimal, simThousands)}`)}</span> ${txtIn} ${i} ${txtYouWouldHave} </span><span class="text-uppercase valor">${formatMoneyDisplay(`${simCurrency} ${formatMoney(result, 2, simDecimal, simThousands)}`)}</span></div>`;
                j++;
            });
            $("#simulators_compare").html(html);

            let resultText = formatMoneyDisplay(`${simCurrency} ${formatMoney(mainTickerResult, 2, simDecimal, simThousands)}`);
            let colorClass = mainTickerResult >= valueSimulator ? 'tw-text-color-text-success-light' : 'tw-text-color-text-error-light';
            $('#index-simulation-result, #index-simulation-result-mobile')
                .removeClass('tw-text-color-text-success-light tw-text-color-text-error-light')
                .addClass(colorClass)
                .html(resultText);
        }

        simulator_compare()

        // Index simulator: input value change -> recalculate
        $('#index-simulation-input').on('change keyup', function () {
            simulator_compare();
        });

        // Index simulator: dropdown change -> sync period buttons + chart
        $('#index-simulation-select').on('change', function () {
            if (indexSimSyncFromButton) return;
            let period = $(this).val();
            if (period > 60 && restrict(userAuth, userIsPro)) { return; }
            $("#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities").removeClass('active');
            $('#compare-index-section .period-profitabilities[data-period=' + period + ']').addClass('active');
            $("#period-profitabilities-select").val(period).trigger('change');
        });
    </script>

        const appDownloadBar = document.getElementById('android-app-download-bar-b2');

            if (!initSession) {
                initSession = Date.now();
                sessionStorage.setItem('initSession', initSession);
            }

            const elapsedTime = Date.now() - initSession;
            if (elapsedTime >= 35000) {
                appDownloadBar.classList.add('show-banner');
            } else {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    appDownloadBar.classList.add('show-banner');
                }, 35000 - elapsedTime);
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const els = document.querySelectorAll('.click-ga-event');
            const ideasMenuLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.ideas-menu a');

            els.forEach((el) => {
                el.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const eventLabel = el.getAttribute('data-event');
                    const eventName = eventLabel.replace(/ /g, '_').replace(/-/g, '_');

                    const eventPayload = {
                        'event_category': 'notification',

                    const click = !appDownloadBar.contains(event.target);
